scope: Independent offline release/evidence validator audit; mutation copies only. No model execution claimed by this sub-review.
issue_method: Problem -> invalid-input hypothesis -> reject invalid/preserve valid acceptance -> patch -> actual probes and unit tests -> frozen logs.

findings.fix: Use exact directory coverage and canonical safe paths for all three source snapshots: exploration, confirmation, rebuild.

findings.fix: Cross-check all inference sidecars across variants and the four tokenizer hashes against frozen tensor identities.

findings.fix: Reject non-regular entries and dot paths before reading members.

already_correct: Archive missing manifest coverage rejected by existing test

acceptance.historical_release_verification: pass; confirmation quality gate remains false; license absent
acceptance.old_rc1_archive: 821 files; original hash matches; validates under hardened parser

fair_verifier_boundary: verify_qwen_prefix_fair intentionally supports runner validation before complete.json exists. Release verification separately requires all six frozen fair-study files through the protected ledger; missing/empty complete.json probes reject. No runner changes.
limits: Checksums are integrity checks, not digital signatures, proof of authorship, or proof that a claimed GPU execution happened. A malicious publisher can replace code and all records coherently.

Archive verify checks the self-contained manifest, not completeness against an external Git tree. A newly re-signed subset is a different artifact; anchor the reviewed commit and final package SHA256 externally and run verify_release after extraction.

Offline model identity verification checks recorded identities and tokenizer consistency. Weights are intentionally absent. Independently loading/re-hashing actual local models is a separate runtime check.
Frozen historical source snapshots remain unchanged; current hardened verifiers validate those old records.
